title: Pre-dynastic Maadi lion cult around the Sphinx

tellings.quote: Well, you have the Mi culture that lived in the area of Giza. And I've always thought that it it was perfectly possible that the Sphinx could have been their god

plain: The suggestion is that the Sphinx, the huge stone lion with a human head at Giza in Egypt, may have been the god of the Maadi, a people who lived around Giza before Egypt's kings began their rule. A researcher named Luke Caverns says he has always thought this was perfectly possible, and he mentions a man named Robert Schoch along the way. If so, the Sphinx would be older than the usual story of the pharaohs.
